item.tib: spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i rgyud las dmar chen drag po'i gtor zlog khrag rkong dmar po'i 'chol mdos
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas gab pa gsung mchog mngon du phyung ba khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i rgyud las dmar chen drag po'i gtor bzlog byad ma sgrol ba'i rkung yig/ khrag rkong dmar po'i 'chol mdos 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum nas gdung rabs rim bzhin du brgyud nas/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ gshen po de yi ring la/ nam mkha' stong pa la rlung gi 'khor los dbang bsgyur te/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa 'char nub kyi skabs su/ bstan pa rin po che gter du gshegs te/ bon 'di rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum du phyes te/ cha cig dang ra khyung rdzong la sbas/ cha gcig thugs la gab/ cha gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la gnyer du bcol/ phyis su lnga snyigs 'dul ba'i dbal bon khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i thugs las chad pa'i bu/ dbal 'bar stag slag can la srid pa'i rgyal mos snyan du brgyud nas bstan pa mi nub dar ba'i rgyu lags pas/ dbal gshen de nyid kyi ring la gdul bya'i smin grol rgya che ba dang / snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams las 'phro zhan stabs phebs pa ma gyur kyang / phran rang la bon sgo 'di yi gtad gnyer yang yang byung bas/ phyis su gyim shod shel brag mjal skabs su/ ma cig srid rgyal khro mo'i tshul gyis bka' yi bkyon pa dang bcas te snyan du brgyud pa'o/ phyis su sprul pa'i sku mchog rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis rin chen maN+Dal bzang pos sna drangs nas bka' gsung pheb pa dang / rang slob 'ga' yis nan cher bskul ba la brten nas/ ldong rigs kyi btsun pa deng sang gi gdag byar gyur ba g.yung drung rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa bdag gis/ ma cig srid rgyal gyis bka' bzhin phral du spel bas/ yi ge pa ni bsgres po sa trig ming gis zlos gar bsgyur te spel ba'o//
